summary: The system layer has a network daemon that owns Wi-Fi, DHCP, routes and link state, and the shell shows it in a Network settings page. Apps get no SDK API for any part of it, and the Apple reachability, interface-configuration, preferences and proxy APIs have no counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/net/wifi.rs (Status: state, ip, router); no host-reachability probe found
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. The daemon reports link and address state only. No API tests whether a named host is reachable, and apps have no client for the state either.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/network_path.rs (PathMonitor::update, PATH_EVENT, path_event); springboard/netd/src/main.rs (Status event on every change); springboard/proto/src/svc.rs
features.note: Apps receive path changes from the shell's network service, and the monitor reports only real changes, with tests. netd polls every 250 ms and pushes a Status event on change; apps cannot subscribe to individual link or address keys.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/network_path.rs (Interface, IfaceKind, Path::interfaces); springboard/src/shell/desktop_network.rs (Interface, kind "ethernet"), springboard/src/net/netlink.rs
features.note: Apps get the interfaces in preference order with their kind (wired, Wi-Fi, cellular, loopback), and tests cover the ordering. Per-interface display name, hardware address and gateway lists are still shell-only.

features.feature: Wi-Fi status, scan, join and saved networks
features.apple: SCNetworkConfiguration (SCNetworkService for Wi-Fi), CoreWLAN-style status through SCNetworkInterface
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 5 (w5-system-configuration, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. netd exposes Scan, Join, Select, Forget, SetAutoJoin, Move and Enable. The SDK client for it is planned, not built (springboard/docs/services.md, Network service and its migration list).

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/system/ipv4_config.rs (Method, manual, mask, prefix_of_mask, network_of); springboard/src/net/dhcp.rs, springboard/src/net/netlink.rs (link_up, add_addr, default_route), springboard/src/net/wifi.rs (Status.ethernet)
features.note: Manual IPv4 settings (address, prefix, router) are validated in the SDK with tests. The shell sets the link up, assigns the address and runs DHCP through netlink, but apps cannot send a configuration to the service yet, and IPv6 settings do not exist.
The page shows Ethernet and Wi-Fi status and links to their pages. It has no service ordering, no network sets or locations, and it cannot edit IP settings.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-system-configuration, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The system has one active Wi-Fi configuration and one wired link. There is no concept of multiple sets or ordered services.

features.apple: SCPreferencesCreate, SCPreferencesGetValue, SCPreferencesSetValue, SCPreferencesCommitChanges, SCPreferencesApplyChanges, SCPreferencesSetCallback
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 5 (theme-10, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. app defaults are per-app. No system-wide, locked, committed configuration store is exposed to apps.

features.feature: Computer name and local host name
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-system-configuration, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Not searched beyond the index. No accessor for the host name was found.

features.feature: Network connections (start, stop, status) for VPN and PPP
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No VPN or dial-up connection type exists in springboard/src/net/.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No system proxy setting was found in springboard/src/net/ or the Network page.
Not part of the desktop network model. Would matter only for a server-class target.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (theme-17, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The login shell exists but no session-user accessor is exposed to apps.

features.bifrost: Rust Result values in springboard/src/net/ modules
features.note: The Apple last-error pattern is specific to the C API. Rust errors cover the same need and need no counterpart.

features.apple: SCSchemaDefinitions (kSCComp*, kSCEnt* keys in the preferences store)
features.note: These keys describe Apple's preferences file layout. BifrOSt stores Wi-Fi settings in its own files (springboard/src/net/wifi_config.rs).
Entitlements are an Apple code-signing mechanism. BifrOSt's sandbox policy is file and process based, not entitlement based.

gaps: No SDK client for the network service (svc::net). Apps cannot read Wi-Fi or link state, which the Apple reachability and dynamic-store APIs would give them. springboard/docs/services.md lists the client as planned.
No reachability test for a named host or address (SCNetworkReachability).
No system-wide preferences store for apps (SCPreferences), and no way to read or set the computer or host name.
No proxy configuration, and no VPN or PPP connection control (SCNetworkConnection).
No network services, sets or locations, so service order and per-location settings do not exist.
The Network page cannot edit IPv4 or IPv6 settings (manual addressing, DNS servers).
